# Buyer Quirk Sheet — City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality

**Buyer:** City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality (Pretoria; departments sampled: Human Settlements, Health, Roads/Community Services, Stores/Supply Chain)
**Kind:** Metro (Category A metropolitan municipality)
**Packs sampled:** 6
- `tshwane-eng-consulting` — Q12-2026-27, invited engineering consulting panel tender (bulk water/sewer/20ML reservoir), Human Settlements Dept.
- `ocds-9t57fa-164836` — Q13-2026-27, impounding of nuisance animals (Health Dept.)
- `ocds-9t57fa-164700` — Q09-01-2026-27, supply/delivery of Boot Concertina RCAB 4110-Kit 3 (Stores, re-advert)
- `ocds-9t57fa-165817` — Q11-2026-27, repair of Bon Accord quarry crusher and asphalt plants
- `ocds-9t57fa-165255` — Q04-01-2026-27, supply/delivery of distribution terminal steel poles (Stores, re-advert)
- `ocds-9t57fa-164389` — Q09-2026-27, supply/delivery of Boot Concertina RCAB 4110-Kit 3 (Stores, first advert)

Date compiled: 2026-08

---

## Submission channel & rules

Tshwane is mid-migration to a mandatory **e-tender portal** and explicitly forbids use of the physical tender box for these tenders — this is stated identically (word-for-word template language) in all five corpus2 packs:

> "The City of Tshwane is migrating to an e-tender portal... Bidders should therefore not deposit their bid responses in the tender box but respond to the bid on the online platform not later than 10:00 on the 13 August 2026." (ocds-9t57fa-164836)

Same clause appears in `ocds-9t57fa-164700`, `ocds-9t57fa-165817`, `ocds-9t57fa-165255`, `ocds-9t57fa-164389` (each with its own closing date/time, all closing at 10:00). No dual-channel or "hard-copy governs" language was found — this is single-channel, electronic-only submission with the box explicitly disabled.

The larger formal/invited tender (eng-consulting pack) confirms the same shift: "Electronic — via the municipality's online tender platform; the physical tender box is explicitly NOT to be used for this tender," while also preserving legacy CIDB sealing/labeling language (original+copy sealed separately, outer package unmarked with bidder identity) as the fallback rule "where applicable" — i.e., the box/sealing convention still exists on paper but is superseded whenever the e-portal applies (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).

Distinctive physical-completion rule that survives the move to e-submission: forms must be filled in **by hand in black pen**, not typed and not scanned-in as a retype:

> "Bid documents must be completed using a black pen (not re-typed or scanned)" (ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389 — identical clause in all five)

Corrections must be struck through in ink and initialled; Tippex/correction fluid on the price schedule is an automatic disqualifier (see Kill rules below).

Telephonic, telegraphic, telex, fax, and email offers are explicitly barred as a submission channel in the eng-consulting pack: "Telephonic, telegraphic, telex, facsimile or e-mailed offers will not be accepted" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).

## Municipal-arrears / rates clause

Consistent **90-day (three-month) arrears cap**, applied both to the bidding entity itself and to every owner/member/director/major shareholder individually — one of Tshwane's most rigorously enforced eligibility gates:

> "Account Statement of the Bidder (bidding company) not older than 3 months and account must not be in arrears for more than ninety (90) days... In addition to the above, confirmation that all the bidding company's owners / members / directors / major shareholders municipal service charges, rates and taxes are up to date... may not be in arrears for more than ninety (90) days" (ocds-9t57fa-164836, lines 401–432; identically worded in ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389)

The eng-consulting formal-tender pack states the same threshold as "3 months": "the tenderer is not in arrears for more than 3 months with municipal rates and taxes and municipal service charges" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`) — the two phrasings (90 days vs. 3 months) are used interchangeably by the buyer but land on the same window.

Bidders in informal settlements/rural areas not billed for rates may substitute a lease agreement or a letter from the local councillor confirming operation in that area (ocds-9t57fa-164836).

## B-BBEE treatment

**Preference points only — not a pre-qualification gate.** All six packs use the standard 80/20 Preferential Procurement Regulations formula (80 points price, 20 points specific goals), and non-submission of a valid B-BBEE certificate costs the bidder the specific-goals points rather than disqualifying the bid outright:

> "The preferential points to be used will be the 80/20 points system" (ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389 — same 80/20 clause in all five)

> "Failure by the tenderer to comply with this clause will result in the tenderer scoring 0 points for preference." (`tshwane-eng-consulting`)

The eng-consulting pack lays out the specific-goals breakdown used by this buyer: B-BBEE level (max 8 pts), EME/QSE status (2 pts), 51%+ women-owned (2 pts), 51%+ owned by people with disabilities (2 pts), 51%+ youth-owned (2 pts), plus a **Local Economic Participation** stack that rewards City-of-Tshwane-based bidders 4 points, Gauteng-based bidders 2 points, and other national bidders 1 point, evidenced by a municipal account statement or lease agreement (`tshwane-eng-consulting`). Certificates must come from a SANAS-accredited verification agency, IRBA-registered auditor, or CCA accounting officer; JV/consortium parties must each submit their own certificate (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).

## Cure/condonation policy

Tshwane runs a fairly mechanical, low-cure regime with one narrow, explicit cure window and otherwise hard fatal-defect treatment:

- **The one cure window observed:** CSD registration proof may be submitted late, within 7 days of request, before disqualification follows — "Additional returnable document; late submission allowed within 7 days on request, else disqualification" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`, RD.C.1). The same 7-day grace applies to the RD.C document series generally: "will result in the Tenderer having to submit same upon request within 7 days and if not complied with, will result to the tender offer being disqualified" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- **Everything else is treated as fatal, not curable:** mandatory returnable documents (RD.A series), authorisation-to-sign resolutions, functionality evidence (RD.D series — scored zero, not requested again), and any Part T2 returnable document are all disqualifying on first miss, with no stated cure path (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- **Non-responsive bids cannot be cured by correction or withdrawal of the offending deviation:** "Reject a non-responsive tender offer, and not allow it to be subsequently made responsive by correction or withdrawal of the non-conforming deviation or reservation" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- The five corpus2 RFQ/quotation packs show no cure language at all for their Stage 1/Stage 2 mandatory-document and mandatory-requirement checks — failure at those stages reads as immediate disqualification with no grace period referenced (ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389). Tax-compliance/PIN status is the one general exception, carrying the same "proof within 7 working days of request" grace seen in the formal tender (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).

## Security/vetting requirements

**Not observed in sampled packs.** No POPIA consent clause, post-award security vetting, integrity pact, or fidelity/security-clearance requirement appears in any of the six packs. The closest analogues found are standard SCM integrity instruments common to South African organs of state generally, not vetting: the MBD 4 declaration of interest of persons in the service of the state (all six packs), the MBD 9 Certificate of Independent Tender Determination / anti-collusion certificate (`tshwane-eng-consulting`, ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-165817), and the Register of Tender Defaulters check under the Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act (all six packs, e.g. "the tenderer or any of its directors is not listed on the Register of Tender Defaulters" — `tshwane-eng-consulting`; "been listed in the Register for Tender Defaulters in terms of section 29" — ocds-9t57fa-164836).

## Financial demands

- **Audited financial statements** for the most recent 3 years (or since incorporation if younger) are required across the board, not only on the large engineering tender — the identical clause appears in all five corpus2 RFQ packs even for modest-value goods/services quotations: "Audited Financial Statements for the most recent three (3) years or Audited Financial Statements from date of existence for companies less than three years old" (ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389). The eng-consulting pack ties this specifically to the >R10m threshold in conjunction with MBD 5 (`tshwane-eng-consulting`); the smaller corpus2 packs request it generally, with an exemption route for bidders not legally required to prepare audited statements ("...required by law to prepare audited financial statements" — ocds-9t57fa-165255).
- **Professional Indemnity Insurance** is required only in the professional-services tender: "Proof of Professional Indemnity Insurance ... Attach original or certified copy; each JV/consortium party must attach its own certificate" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`). Not observed in the five goods/services RFQ packs.
- **Compensation Fund / COIDA good-standing** is a hard eligibility gate on the eng-consulting pack: "the tenderer is registered and in good standing with the compensation fund or with a licensed compensation insurer" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- **Bank guarantees / performance bonds / bank ratings letters:** Not observed in sampled packs.
- Tax compliance (via CSD/PIN) is required across all six packs as a hard gate, with the 7-day cure window noted above.

## Functionality norms

Functionality evaluation style differs by procurement type in this sample:

- **Formal/high-value tender (eng-consulting):** classic 100-point weighted scoring with a **70/100 minimum threshold** to proceed to price/preference — "Only those tenderers who score a minimum of 70 points ... are eligible to submit tenders" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`). Scoring is heavily staff-weighted (60/100 on key-personnel experience vs. 40/100 on firm track record), and every experience claim requires a signed appointment letter plus completion certificate on client letterhead, or it scores zero — no partial credit (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- **Quotation-level RFQs (corpus2 packs):** no points-based functionality stage was found; instead the buyer runs a pass/fail "Stage 2: Mandatory Requirements" checklist (facility ownership/lease proof, equipment specs, signed reference letters on company letterhead) followed directly by a site inspection stage, then straight to the 80/20 preference-point stage — e.g. "Stage 1: Administrative Compliance / Stage 2: Mandatory Requirements / Stage 3: Site Inspection / Stage 4: Preference Point System" (ocds-9t57fa-164836); comparable 2–3 stage sequences appear in ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389. Failure on any mandatory-requirement item disqualifies outright rather than scoring low: "Failure to attach the above will result in the bid being disqualified and will not be evaluated further" (ocds-9t57fa-164836).

## Distinctive kill rules / quirks

- **E-portal-only submission with the tender box explicitly disabled**, paired paradoxically with a hand-completion-in-black-pen requirement ("not re-typed or scanned") — bidders must fill forms by hand, then presumably scan for upload, all five corpus2 packs, identical wording.
- **Tippex/correction-fluid on the price schedule is an automatic, named disqualifier**, distinct from the general "no unsigned corrections" rule: "Bidder will be disqualified should they use tippex/ correction ink, on the price schedule" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`; identical clause in ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389).
- **Incomplete pricing schedules are treated as an automatic disqualification, not a scoring penalty**, unless the tender is explicitly awarded per item/section: "Incomplete pricing schedule results in totals being incomparable. Bidder must be disqualified" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`, ocds-9t57fa-164836).
- **90-day arrears check reaches beyond the bidding entity to every owner, member, director, and major shareholder individually** — unusually broad compared to buyers that check only the bidding entity (all five corpus2 packs; consistent template language).
- **Local Economic Participation is scored in a strict geographic tier — City of Tshwane > Gauteng > rest of South Africa (4/2/1 points)** — stacked on top of, not instead of, the standard B-BBEE specific-goals points, so a Pretoria-registered bidder gets a real scoring edge over an out-of-province competitor even at equal B-BBEE level (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- **Compulsory briefing sessions are absolute gates with no cure**: "Bidders will be disqualified should they fail to attend compulsory briefing session," and tender documents/addenda are only released to names on the signed attendance register (`tshwane-eng-consulting`, ocds-9t57fa-164836).
- **Audited financial statements are demanded even for small-value goods/services RFQs** (boot concertinas, steel poles, crusher repairs), not reserved for high-value contracts — a heavier documentary burden at the low end of spend than many municipalities apply (ocds-9t57fa-164836, ocds-9t57fa-164700, ocds-9t57fa-165817, ocds-9t57fa-165255, ocds-9t57fa-164389).
- **MBD-series forms (not the newer national SBD numbering) remain Tshwane's standard form set** — MBD 4, MBD 6.1, MBD 8, MBD 9 named explicitly and consistently across every pack in the sample, with a mechanical ink-integrity check layered on top: "Documents completed in black ink (i.e. no 'Tippex' corrections, no pencil, no other colour ink, or non-submission of the MBD forms, will not be considered)" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`).
- **Invited/panel-restricted tendering exists alongside open RFQs at this buyer**: the eng-consulting pack is closed to all but tenderers already appointed under a parent framework contract — "Only those tenderers who were accepted for Contract COO 01-2021/22 (HS10-2026) and were specifically invited for this tender will be eligible to tender" (`tshwane-eng-consulting`) — worth checking on every Tshwane opportunity whether it is open-market or panel-restricted before investing bid effort.
